files.tariff-card.md:
# Coldharbour Freight - Westgate lane weight tariff

Effective 1 March 2026. Charges are per consignment and are set from the
billed weight shown on the manifest.

| Billed weight | Charge (GBP) |
|---|---|
| up to 20 kg | 18.60 |
| over 20 kg up to 40 kg | 27.45 |
| over 40 kg | 38.90 |
files.lane-conditions.md:
# Westgate lane conditions

These conditions are read alongside the weight tariff in tariff-card.md
and settle how a consignment is charged.

- A consignment billed at 40 kg or under is charged the tariff charge for
  its weight band.
- A consignment billed above 40 kg is charged 38.90 for the first 40 kg
  and 6.20 for each further 5 kg or part thereof.
files.README.md:
# Coldharbour Freight - Westgate lane account

The Westgate lane is invoiced monthly from the consignment manifest in
manifest_march_2026.csv. tariff-card.md carries the weight tariff and
lane-conditions.md carries the conditions that apply to the lane.
Charges are in GBP.
